description: Commits selected files within selected workspace items to the connected Git repository.
notes: Commit is LRO (returns 202, polls until Succeeded/Failed). Use --all for every change, --items ID1,ID2 for item-level selection, or repeat --file-selection ITEM_ID=PATH[,PATH...] for FileLevelSelective mode. An empty path list (ITEM_ID=) commits all files in that item. workspaceHead is auto-fetched from git status.

query_examples.description: Error details if failed (null on success).
